rows.resolution_note: p001 sentence 31 defines the DECODE cohort of this paper as the pQTL study of 35,559 Icelandic participants with 4907 proteins (Ferkingstad et al., 2021, DOI 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w), used as an exposure dataset in every other passage; that dataset has rows only on the pqtl side and the outcome side has no row for it (rule C2).
rows.quote: We sourced summary‐level genetic association data on 4907 circulating proteins from an extensive pQTL study involving 35,559 Icelandic participants, known as the DECODE cohort (Ferkingstad et al., 2021).
